title: Leviticus Bible Quiz - Chapter 26
description: Ten questions on Leviticus 26: Yahweh's blessings for obedience, the punishments for breaking his covenant, and his promise to remember it.

questions.text: Besides idols, carved images and pillars, what were the Israelites not to place in their land to bow down to?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 forbids idols, a carved image, a pillar, or any figured stone to bow down to.

questions.text: What did Yahweh promise to give if they walked in his statutes?
questions.explanation: If they kept his commandments, he would give them rains in their season, and the land and trees would yield their fruit.

questions.text: According to verse 8, five of them would chase how many?
questions.explanation: Verse 8 says five of them would chase a hundred, and a hundred of them would chase ten thousand.

questions.text: What did Yahweh promise to set among his people?
questions.explanation: Verse 11 says, "I will set my tent among you, and my soul won't abhor you."

questions.text: Having broken the bars of their yoke, what did Yahweh do for Israel?
questions.explanation: Yahweh brought them out of Egypt so they would not be slaves; he broke the bars of their yoke and made them walk upright.

answers.text: He made them kings over Egypt
He gave them wings like eagles
He carried them on his shoulders

questions.text: If they still would not listen, what would Yahweh make their sky like?
questions.explanation: If they still would not listen, Yahweh would break the pride of their power and make their sky like iron and their soil like bronze.

questions.text: When Yahweh broke their staff of bread, how many women would bake their bread in one oven?
questions.explanation: Verse 26 says ten women would bake their bread in one oven and give it out by weight, and they would eat and not be satisfied.

questions.text: What would the land enjoy while it lay desolate and the people were in their enemies' land?
questions.explanation: Verse 34 says the land would rest and enjoy its Sabbaths as long as it lay desolate.

questions.text: What would put to flight those who were left in the lands of their enemies?
questions.explanation: Yahweh would send faintness into their hearts, so that the sound of a driven leaf would put them to flight.

answers.text: The sound of a driven leaf

questions.text: If they confessed their iniquity, which covenant would Yahweh remember?
questions.explanation: Verse 42 says he would remember his covenant with Jacob, with Isaac and with Abraham, and he would remember the land.

answers.text: His covenant with Noah after the flood
His covenant with David and his house
His covenant with Jacob, Isaac and Abraham
His covenant with Adam in the garden
